known.summary: `installBun` downloads the Bun install script over plain `http://bun.sh/install` and then runs the file with bash. Nothing checks the downloaded script, so a network attacker can answer the first request and run any shell code as the user during `docks-kit sync` (CWE-494, download of code without an integrity check). The pull request adds bun.ts: the base has no such file and no Bun bootstrap.
